abstract: Of 36 cases of choriocarcinoma treated at the University Hospital Kuala Lumpur during 1980-84 inclusive, 6 patients were found to have cerebral metastases. Intrathecal methotrexate and combination chemotherapy were started in all cases, with monitoring of tumor growth by serial beta-HCG assays and CT scanning of brain and lung. Chemotherapy was reduced because of severe toxicity in 2 patients, one of whom received radiotherapy to the brain. Four patients (66%) have now been in remission for 2.5-6 years. Two did not respond to therapy and died. The factors involved in therapy and response are discussed.
abstract_ja: 1980~1984年にクアラルンプール大学病院で治療された絨毛癌36例のうち、6例に脳転移を認めた。全例に髄腔内メトトレキサートと併用化学療法を開始し、連続的β-hCG測定と脳および肺のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)による腫瘍増殖の評価を行った。重篤な毒性のため2例では化学療法を減量し、そのうち1例は脳への放射線療法を受けた。4例(66%)は2.5~6年間寛解を維持している。2例は治療に反応せず死亡した。治療と反応に関わる因子について考察する。
